body:
With the `climacoupler-downstream` buildkite pipeline, the concurrency limit can stop ClimaCore coupler downstream test and vice versa. This is due to the `concurrency_group` being the same for both pipelines. This PR updates `concurrency_group` to depot/${BUILDKITE_PIPELINE_SLUG}'. For the ClimaCoupler CI, this is `depot/climacoupler-ci` and for the land downstream tests, this is `depot/climacoupler-downstream`.

This is the same kind of change in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/pull/1940.
title: Update concurrency group to use pipeline slug
